positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Migrated applications to AWS via Chef and Terraform.  As well as utilizing AWS features such as SQS, SNS, and S3 buckets. 

- Updated applications to provide metrics for performance, alerting, and trouble shooting information.  

- Lead public API development team, using OAuth 2.0, Spring Boot, Swagger, Elastic Beanstalk, and AWS API Gateway to quickly build a scalable infrastructure.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Implemented a server side mechanism to prevent a single cloud user from consuming an unfair share of backend resources. This greatly improved the customer experience as one rogue account can no longer negatively impact thousands of other users.. 

• Owner of back-end and front-end cross platform (Linux/Mac/Windows) C++ network layer providing primary communication between the cloud and desktop clients.  

• Lead efforts in memory management on front-end resulting in a 10x improvement in desktop client memory usage.

• Monitored server performance at data centers and worked closely with the operations team to tune NIC, IRQ, power settings, etc...

• Resolved complex customer support tickets.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Designed and implemented the company’s Linux C++ framework, which included configurable threading, assignment of modules to cores, and TCP/UDP/Multicast network connectivity services. 
 
•	Lead C++ software architecture efforts to reduce application latency and increase scalability.  Resulted in a decrease of application message latency to a fourth of its original value while handling twenty to thirty times more messaging volume.

•	Supported trading platform service which operated 24x7 (Foreign Exchange Trading Hours) from Sunday through Friday.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
R&D Project– Lead Software Engineer
•	Designed and implemented cross platform modular N-Tier C++ publish subscribe middleware solution for use across all Boeing Products requiring communication on government simulation networks.   This project involved 300,000+ lines of code, utilized many design patterns, and the integration of legacy products. (HLA, DIS, Visual Studio 2003/2005, with Linux build via make files) 

•	Updated and improved legacy unsupported C++ software for automatic generation of network message handling code.  Allowing middleware to adapt to an evolving messaging specification automatically.  This involved heavy use of templates and function objects.

•	Boeing Subject Matter Expert at Navy Continuous Training Environment (NCTE) and Navy Aviation Simulation Master Plan (NASMP) working groups; where new interoperability standards, messages, and network protocols are approved.
